description: Defines the TemplateURL class, a PHP class extending TemplateText, used for URL fields in SuiteCRM's dynamic fields module. Contains methods for rendering HTML, processing URL details, and generating field definitions.

classes.name: TemplateURL
classes.description: A PHP class for URL field templates in SuiteCRM, extending TemplateText, with properties and methods for URL handling and rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TemplateURL object, setting up vardef mappings for 'ext4' and 'link_target'.

methods.name: get_html_edit
methods.description: Returns HTML for editing the URL field as a text input.

methods.name: get_html_detail
methods.description: Returns HTML for displaying the URL as a clickable link.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Processes the URL value for display, prepending 'http://' if necessary.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Generates and returns the field definition array for database and form use.
